channel.title: Morning News for Niklas
channel.description: A short weekday morning briefing: top news from Sweden and the world, plus tech.
channel.itunes:author: Claude

item.title: Morning news – Wednesday 18 November 2026
item.description: • Iran and the US trade strikes in the Gulf; tankers hit mines in Hormuz • Trump, Xi and Putin to meet Thursday; Europeans join Ukraine talks ahead of Berlin • Speaker Norlén sets pre-Christmas deadline for Sweden's new government • Church of Sweden postpones decision on priests' right to refuse same-sex weddings • COP31 draft calls for accelerated fossil fuel phase-out • Nvidia posts $115.8B quarter; board rules out Jensen Huang's return • Anthropic set for Nasdaq debut Thursday in one of the largest IPOs ever • Wave of US tech outages hits Apple, NSA network, banks and airlines • Klarna narrows Q3 loss to $65M as revenue grows 12% • Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
item.content:encoded:
• Iran and the US trade strikes in the Gulf; tankers hit mines in Hormuz
  • Trump, Xi and Putin to meet Thursday; Europeans join Ukraine talks ahead of Berlin
  • Speaker Norlén sets pre-Christmas deadline for Sweden's new government
  • Church of Sweden postpones decision on priests' right to refuse same-sex weddings
  • COP31 draft calls for accelerated fossil fuel phase-out
  • Nvidia posts $115.8B quarter; board rules out Jensen Huang's return
  • Anthropic set for Nasdaq debut Thursday in one of the largest IPOs ever
  • Wave of US tech outages hits Apple, NSA network, banks and airlines
  • Klarna narrows Q3 loss to $65M as revenue grows 12%
  • Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
